pwsbuilder May 7, 2018

Presentation by Angela Zoni Mault, Executive Director of Creative Arts Center in Chatham. This will be a critique of member paintings, bring a painting with you for a review. This annual event is always so informative for all of us!

The Guild of Harwich Artists hold monthly meetings January through June, and in October and November, at the Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak Street, Harwich, MA. Each meeting features a well-known Cape artist demonstrator. All programs are free and open to the public with light refreshments served.
